rows.displayName: A torsion-free counterexample to reduced Baum–Connes injectivity

claim.ja: 有限生成torsion-free群で係数なし被約assemblyの無限位数の核類を構成し、有理単射性の失敗を主張する。
claim.en: Claims an infinite-order kernel class for coefficient-free reduced assembly of a finitely generated torsion-free group, hence failure of rational injectivity.

role.ja: トーラスのコホモロジー検出とBott類の被約像消滅を別々に構成し、有限生成の証人へまとめる。
role.en: Combines cohomological detection of a torus with vanishing of its reduced Bott class, retaining both in a finitely generated witness.

rows.displayName: A torsion-free counterexample to the Kadison–Kaplansky projection conjecture

claim.ja: 有限生成torsion-free群のscalar被約群C*環に0<τ(p)<1/2の射影を構成し、Kadison–Kaplansky射影予想の反例を主張する。
claim.en: Claims a projection with 0<τ(p)<1/2 in the scalar reduced group C*-algebra of a finitely generated torsion-free group, contradicting the projection conjecture.

role.ja: torsionを排除した群で行列射影の小さな正トレースを得て、自由積内の行圧縮でscalar射影へ移す。
role.en: Constructs a matrix projection of small positive trace in a torsion-free group, then compresses it to a scalar projection in a free product.

rows.displayName: An irrational-trace counterexample to reduced Baum–Connes

claim.ja: 有限生成群の被約群C*環に無理数トレースの射影を構成し、係数なし被約assemblyの全射性の失敗を主張する。torsion-freeは仮定しない。
claim.en: Claims an irrational-trace projection for a finitely generated group, obstructing surjectivity of coefficient-free reduced assembly; no torsion-free condition is imposed.

role.ja: 符号から正確な局所確率を作り、全体のspectral gapで射影をC*環内へ置く。トレースを有理なassembly像と比較する。
role.en: Code relations give exact local probabilities; a global spectral gap places the projection in the C*-algebra. Its trace is compared with the rational trace of the assembly image.
